title: Waves – Rising
statement:
Where water becomes vertical presence.

WAVES — Rising reframes fluid motion into an architectural format. Instead of stretching across a horizon, the composition ascends — drawing the eye upward through reflective aquamarine surfaces and sculptural folds of light.

The movement is continuous yet controlled. Nothing crashes. Nothing demands.

The surface breathes.

Highlights travel across liquid contours with precision, creating a quiet interplay between luminosity and depth. The vertical orientation intensifies intimacy — transforming the work from cinematic landscape into immersive presence.

Designed as a refined digital atmosphere, the piece exists between sculpture and light — contemplative, spatial, and endlessly returning.
